answer: Ninety anonymous cargo pledges sat on one berth until the same wallet cluster filed 12 wreck claims in a week. Each new pledge lodges a 2.4-unit onyx bond plus a sealed voyage log before the payout desk opens. A clerk hashes that log against a spiral of 6 prior port stamps; if fewer than 4 match the bonded route, the claim stays frozen 36 hours. The check costs 0.18 units and the hash stays on a public board for 48 hours so rivals can contest it. If a stamp is later reused on two wrecks, 80 percent of the bond is slashed and that signer is barred for 14 days; honest parties keep the residual.
